design: All10 frozen dictionaries/support encoders; all78 H849 pairs both directions. Project rawpreMLP4 donor contrast into union of native donor/recipient active atoms, then optionally constrain frozen task-direction coefficient. No normalization after patch, unlikeH854 shape/radius interventions.
formula: P=QQ^T; p=Pdelta; constrained=p+Pq*(q^T(delta-p))/(q^TPq). Unique nearest-vector solution in span with q^Tedit=q^Tdelta. Use exact float64 SVD span, threshold1e-10 relative; reject unrepresentable coefficient if q^TPq<1e-10.
arms: Euclidean projection; own-task constrained; other-task constrained control; Euclidean direction rescaled to own-constrained totalnorm; minimum-norm edit in span matching owncoordinate. Full rawdonor and direct rank1 frozen-coordinate references.
scope: Explicitly supervised oracle diagnostic; not unsupervised featurizer or taskblind improvement. Norm and geometry costs reported; scalar matching alone need not imply downstream fidelity. All seeds/variants retained.
